name: offer-brief
title: Private offer terms brief
for_each: select id,name from campaigns order by name

sections.title: Coupon conditions
sections.sql: select code,kind,value,max_discount_cents,starts_at,expires_at,redemption_limit,reviewed_by,review_note from coupons where campaign_id=$1 order by code
sections.note: Percent values are basis points: 1000 means 10%. Amount values are minor currency units: 500 means 5.00.

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where campaign_id=$1

name: redemption-statement
title: Local coupon redemption statement
for_each: select id,name from campaigns order by name

sections.title: Recorded use
sections.sql: select c.code,r.order_ref,r.customer_ref,r.currency,r.order_cents,r.discount_cents,r.created_at,exists(select 1 from reversals x where x.redemption_id=r.id) as reversed from redemptions r join coupons c on c.id=r.coupon_id where c.campaign_id=$1 order by r.created_at
sections.note: Imported usage is a count only. Financial history and customer attribution before cutover require separate reconciliation.
